description: PHP class 'mbinfo' providing system health monitoring functions such as temperature, fan speeds, and voltage readings, utilizing external program 'healthdc'.

classes.name: mbinfo
classes.description: A class for retrieving system health metrics like temperature, fan speeds, and voltages.

methods.name: temperature
methods.description: Retrieves temperature readings from the system using 'healthdc -t'.

methods.name: fans
methods.description: Retrieves fan speed data from the system using 'healthdc -t'.

methods.name: voltage
methods.description: Retrieves voltage readings from the system using 'healthdc -t'.
